zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: First town on the way to Hallownest; located in the valley between Howling Cliffs and Crystal Peak; initially one resident (Elderbug); bugs can return or move in.

zones.name: King's Pass
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area of Dirtmouth; entry point into Hallownest.

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Area along which Zote is first found trapped by a Vengefly King.

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found in a corridor leading to its storerooms.

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found stuck in spider webs, captured by beasts of Deepnest.

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote held in resting area; final boss of first trial if Knight saved Zote twice.

zones.name: Crystal Peak
zones.fingerprintHint: Adjacent to Dirtmouth; connected via the valley.

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Connected to Dirtmouth.

zones.name: Howling Cliffs
zones.fingerprintHint: Adjacent to Dirtmouth on the other side of the valley.

zones.name: Graveyard
zones.fingerprintHint: East of Dirtmouth town centre, leads to a stone door requiring a Simple Key.

zones.name: Confessor Jiji's Cave
zones.fingerprintHint: Cave behind a stone door east of Dirtmouth, requires Simple Key; contains Confessor Jiji (normal mode) or Steel Soul Jinn (Steel Soul Mode).

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.fingerprintHint: Location where the Love Key is found.

zones.name: Tower of Love
zones.fingerprintHint: Door unlocked by the Love Key; the Collector can be fought inside.

zones.name: Mantis Village
zones.fingerprintHint: Location where Elder Hu was killed by the Mantis Tribe

zones.name: Fungal Wastes
zones.fingerprintHint: Connected via path below southeast Queen's Gardens

zones.name: Fog Canyon
zones.fingerprintHint: Connected to Forgotten Crossroads

zones.name: Resting Grounds
zones.fingerprintHint: Connected to Forgotten Crossroads

zones.name: Ancestral Mound
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area within Forgotten Crossroads

zones.name: Temple of the Black Egg
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area within Forgotten Crossroads

zones.name: Infected Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Infection-overrun version of Forgotten Crossroads

zones.name: Grubhome
zones.fingerprintHint: Located in the northwest of Forgotten Crossroads; home to Grubfather

zones.name: Hot Spring
zones.fingerprintHint: Located in the south of Forgotten Crossroads

zones.name: Aspid Nest
zones.fingerprintHint: Special room within the Forgotten Crossroads

zones.name: Deserted Village
zones.fingerprintHint: Special sub-area within Forgotten Crossroads

zones.name: Lake of Unn
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area of Greenpath, associated with Unn.

zones.name: Stone Sanctuary
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area of Greenpath.

zones.name: Sheo's Hut
zones.fingerprintHint: Located in the southwest sector of Greenpath at the end of a challenging thorn-filled path; Great Slash Nail Art learned here

zones.name: Acidic Lake
zones.fingerprintHint: Acid water lake in northwest Greenpath

zones.name: Queen's Station
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area of Fungal Wastes

zones.name: Fungal Core
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area of Fungal Wastes

zones.name: Royal Waterways
zones.fingerprintHint: Connected to Fungal Wastes

zones.name: Kingdom's Edge
zones.fingerprintHint: Connected to City of Tears

zones.name: Soul Sanctum
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area of City of Tears

zones.name: Fountain Square
zones.fingerprintHint: Centre of City of Tears, memorial fountain to the Hollow Knight, Hornet and Lemm found here

zones.name: Pleasure House
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area in a tower, only Hot Spring in the city, eastern side

zones.name: Watcher's Spire
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area on eastern side, Lurien the Watcher's telescope, home of Watcher Knights boss

zones.name: King's Station
zones.fingerprintHint: Sub-area Stag Station in the very eastern part of the city

zones.name: City Storerooms
zones.fingerprintHint: Special room sub-area, western side, has Stag Station

zones.name: Ancient Basin
zones.fingerprintHint: Accessible via Tram Pass; leads up to east City of Tears

zones.name: Hallownest
zones.fingerprintHint: The overarching world/kingdom setting of Hollow Knight

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads Stag Station
zones.fingerprintHint: Stag station inside Forgotten Crossroads; costs 50 Geo to activate; connects to Dirtmouth via Last Stag

zones.name: Hot Springs / Bench Room
zones.fingerprintHint: Reached by dropping down right from the Geo Cluster area; contains hot springs and a bench

zones.name: Locked Room (Bee Encounter)
zones.fingerprintHint: Gates close on entry; one bee then two more bees attack before gates reopen; bottom-left path leads to 3 Geo Clusters

zones.name: Isma's Grove
zones.fingerprintHint: Purple/violet light, mossy stone brickwork, green dripping stalactites, glowing white-purple explosion effect

zones.name: The Abyss
zones.fingerprintHint: Pitch black void, void liquid/sibling entities, lighthouse structure, dark rocky platforms with moss/growths

zones.name: Abyss Lighthouse
zones.fingerprintHint: Top of platforming section inside the Abyss, contains soul and a lever

zones.name: Shade Cloak Chamber
zones.fingerprintHint: Right side of the falling void liquid room in the Abyss, contains Shade Cloak and an Arcane Egg

abilities.note: Given by Sly as the Nailsage

abilities.name: Grimmchild

abilities.name: Carefree Melody
abilities.note: Given by Nymm if the troupe has been banished

abilities.name: Crystal Heart
abilities.note: Used to traverse from Crystal Peak westward into King's Pass

abilities.name: Glowing Womb
abilities.note: Point of interest / item found in Forgotten Crossroads

abilities.name: City Crest
abilities.note: Point of interest / item found in Forgotten Crossroads

abilities.name: Vengeful Spirit
abilities.note: Granted by the Snail Shaman; after obtaining it the Knight falls unconscious and awakens behind a locked gate

abilities.name: World Sense
abilities.note: Acquired from the Lore Tablet next to the Bench

abilities.name: Great Slash Nail Art
abilities.note: Learned from Sheo, located in the southwest sector of Greenpath past a path full of thorns and Durandas

abilities.name: Mothwing Cloak
abilities.note: Acquired after defeating Hornet Protector

abilities.name: Great Slash
abilities.note: Nail Art found in Greenpath; location of Nailmaster Sheo

abilities.name: Thorns of Agony
abilities.note: Charm/ability found in Greenpath

abilities.name: Shape of Unn
abilities.note: Found in a hidden area to the west of the acidic lake, given by Unn herself

abilities.name: Lumafly Lantern
abilities.note: Can illuminate Stone Sanctuary

abilities.name: Mark of Pride
abilities.note: Charm found in chest in Mantis Village after defeating Mantis Lords

abilities.name: Dashmaster
abilities.note: Charm found in southeast Fungal Wastes

abilities.name: Spore Shroom
abilities.note: Charm found in southwest Fungal Wastes near Deepnest

abilities.name: Charm Notch
abilities.note: Acquired after defeating two Shrumal Ogres in north Fungal Wastes

abilities.name: Mask Shard
abilities.note: Acquired after obtaining Mantis Claw

abilities.name: Fragile Charms
abilities.note: Sold by Leg Eater in his shop in the northeast Fungal Wastes

abilities.name: Crest
abilities.note: Equipment interface with limited slots used to equip Tools; changed at a Bench

abilities.name: Desolate Dive
abilities.note: Spell guarded by Soul Master

abilities.name: Shade Soul

abilities.name: Simple Key
abilities.note: Required to open the Pleasure House

abilities.name: Elegant Key
abilities.note: Required to obtain Shade Soul in City of Tears

abilities.name: Monarch Wings
abilities.note: Referenced as required to normally reach a high Grub and Salubra's shop; not acquired in this segment

abilities.name: Wayward Compass
abilities.note: Charm purchasable from Iselda in Dirtmouth; recommended for exploration

abilities.name: Quill
abilities.note: Purchasable from Iselda in Dirtmouth; needed for map exploration

abilities.name: Hunter's Journal
abilities.note: Given by The Hunter NPC

abilities.name: Wanderer's Journal
abilities.note: Found in secret room behind breakable wall near Greenpath Stag Station

abilities.name: King's Brand
abilities.note: Required to open the door at the bottom of Ancient Basin leading to the Abyss and Shade Cloak

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Holds Zote in its mandibles; Knight can choose to fight it to save Zote or leave.

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of first trial if saved both in Greenpath and Deepnest. Deals no damage due to shellwood nail (Life Ender). Beating him grants Rivalry achievement.

bosses.name: False Knight
bosses.note: Defeating False Knight is one of two triggers for Iselda's map shop to open in Dirtmouth.

bosses.name: Collector
bosses.note: Fought inside the Tower of Love after opening the door with the Love Key.

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Spirit of a travelling sage fought at his memorial above City of Tears gates. Attacks: Ring Slam (row of rings slammed down with safe gaps), Ring Curtain (pairs of rings from arena edges toward centre), Teleport. Drops 100 Essence on defeat. Requires Dream Nail to access.

bosses.name: Grey Prince Zote
bosses.note: Boss found in Dirtmouth

bosses.name: Grimm
bosses.note: Boss found in Dirtmouth; defeating yields a Charm Notch

bosses.name: Nightmare King Grimm
bosses.note: Boss found in Dirtmouth; alternate form of Grimm

bosses.name: Gruz Mother
bosses.note: East of the Hot Spring, sleeping in a church

bosses.name: Brooding Mawlek
bosses.note: Hidden behind a breakable wall, south of the room near the Hot Spring

bosses.name: Hollow Knight
bosses.note: One of two bosses fought within the Temple of the Black Egg

bosses.name: The Radiance
bosses.note: One of two bosses fought within the Temple of the Black Egg

bosses.name: Failed Champion
bosses.note: Dream boss listed under Forgotten Crossroads bosses

bosses.name: Snail Shaman
bosses.note: Grants the Vengeful Spirit Spell to the Knight

bosses.name: Elder Baldur
bosses.note: Killing it opens the locked gate inside the Ancestral Mound

bosses.name: Mantis Lords
bosses.note: Killed Elder Hu after he attacked them, mistaking them for Infected

bosses.name: Hornet
bosses.note: Fought in an arena in the northwest part of Greenpath, to the right of the Lake of Unn

bosses.name: Hornet Protector
bosses.note: Boss in Greenpath; defeating her yields the Mothwing Cloak

bosses.name: Massive Moss Charger
bosses.note: Boss enemy in Greenpath

bosses.name: No Eyes
bosses.note: Warrior Dream resting in Stone Sanctuary, southeast Greenpath

bosses.name: Shrumal Ogres
bosses.note: Two found in north Fungal Wastes; defeating them yields a Charm Notch

bosses.name: Soul Master
bosses.note: Located in Soul Sanctum on the western side of City of Tears

bosses.name: Watcher Knights
bosses.note: Located in Watcher's Spire on the eastern side of City of Tears

bosses.name: Soul Warrior
bosses.note: Boss listed among City of Tears inhabitants

bosses.name: Soul Tyrant
bosses.note: Boss listed among City of Tears inhabitants

bosses.name: Mawlek
bosses.note: User comment questions why Mawlek is not listed on the Forgotten Crossroads wiki page, implying it resides here

bosses.name: Hornet (Boss)
bosses.note: Fast boss; drops Mothwing Cloak on defeat; fought in arena at end of long corridor

bosses.name: Mantis Youth
bosses.note: Two Mantis Youths guard the room containing Mantis Claw

bosses.name: Broken Vessel
bosses.note: Encountered in an infected corridor blocked by goop; must be defeated to open the door leading to Monarch Wings. Shown as a massive shadowy creature looming over the Knight in the keyframes.

bosses.name: Dung Defender
bosses.note: Must be defeated before the player can access Isma's Grove; his mire/lair is in the bottom-right of Royal Waterways

objectives.name: Descend into the caverns below Dirtmouth
objectives.hopDescription: Head down the well in Dirtmouth into the caverns of Hallownest below.
objectives.note: As described by Elderbug: other residents disappeared heading down the well one by one.

objectives.name: Optionally save Zote from the Vengefly King
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to Greenpath and defeat the Vengefly King to free Zote before acquiring Mantis Claw.

objectives.name: Optionally save Zote in Deepnest
objectives.hopDescription: Find Zote trapped in spider webs in Deepnest and choose to rescue him.

objectives.name: Optionally defeat Zote at the Colosseum of Fools
objectives.hopDescription: If Zote was saved in both Greenpath and Deepnest, fight him as the final boss of the first Colosseum trial.

objectives.name: Break down King's Pass stone door
objectives.hopDescription: Break through the stone door at King's Pass to enter Dirtmouth and begin the journey through Hallownest.

objectives.name: Open Iselda's map shop
objectives.hopDescription: Either purchase a Map or defeat False Knight to prompt Iselda to open her map shop next to the Stag Station in Dirtmouth.

objectives.name: Use Simple Key on cave door
objectives.hopDescription: Find a Simple Key and use it to open the stone door east of Dirtmouth's graveyard to access Confessor Jiji's cave.
objectives.note: Requires Simple Key key item.

objectives.name: Activate the lift to Crystal Peak
objectives.hopDescription: Pull the lever near the mines' entrances to activate the lift above the cave door, granting access to Crystal Peak.

objectives.name: Acquire the Dream Nail
objectives.hopDescription: Obtain the Dream Nail to unlock the ability to fight Elder Hu's spirit at his memorial

objectives.name: Fight Elder Hu's spirit at his memorial
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to Elder Hu's memorial above the gates of the City of Tears and use the Dream Nail to initiate the fight
objectives.note: Dodge Ring Slam and Ring Curtain attacks; Shade Cloak highly recommended

objectives.name: Collect Essence from Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: Use the Dream Nail to collect 100 Essence after Elder Hu's spirit shatters

objectives.name: Obtain the Love Key
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the southeast of Queen's Gardens, above the path to Fungal Wastes, and retrieve the Love Key from a corpse — requires Isma's Tear

objectives.name: Use the Love Key
objectives.hopDescription: Bring the Love Key to its corresponding location in the City of Tears

objectives.name: Defeat boss with Spell build
objectives.hopDescription: Equip Shaman Stone, Spell Twister, Soul Catcher, Soul Eater; use Shade Cloak to dodge Ring Slam, then cast Howling Wraiths or Abyss Shriek to finish quickly
objectives.note: Alternative strategy segment

objectives.name: Fight Elder Hu's spirit
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to Elder Hu's memorial above the gates to the City of Tears and use the Dream Nail to engage his spirit
objectives.note: Requires Dream Nail to be acquired first

objectives.name: Dream Nail the Husk Dandy corpse
objectives.hopDescription: Locate the large dead Husk Dandy holding the Love Key in Queen's Gardens and use the Dream Nail on it
objectives.note: Provides lore dialogue: 'Too long... spent together. We become as one...'

objectives.name: Enter Hallownest via the well
objectives.hopDescription: Descend into Dirtmouth's old well to reach the Forgotten Crossroads and the ruins of Hallownest

objectives.name: Fight and defeat Elder Hu at his memorial
objectives.hopDescription: Use the Dream Nail at Elder Hu's memorial above the City of Tears gates; dodge Ring Slam and Ring Curtain attacks using precise movement or Shade Cloak, striking with Nail or Spells in between
objectives.note: Optional Spell build: Shaman Stone, Spell Twister, Soul Catcher, Soul Eater + Howling Wraiths/Abyss Shriek

objectives.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: After defeating Elder Hu, use the Dream Nail to collect the 100 Essence he scatters

objectives.name: Dream Nail the Husk Dandy corpse holding the Love Key
objectives.hopDescription: In Queen's Gardens, Dream Nail the large dead Husk Dandy to receive lore dialogue
objectives.note: Dialogue: 'Too long... spent together. We become as one...'

objectives.name: Enter Dirtmouth via King's Pass
objectives.hopDescription: Break down the door at the very end of King's Pass to access Dirtmouth for the first time

objectives.name: Save Zote from the Vengefly King
objectives.hopDescription: Find Zote held in the mandibles of a Vengefly King along the path to Greenpath and defeat the Vengefly King to rescue him
objectives.note: Optional; leaving him leads to his death if Mantis Claw is acquired first

objectives.name: Save Zote from Deepnest
objectives.hopDescription: Find Zote stuck in spider webs in Deepnest and free him
objectives.note: Optional; leaving him this time does not result in his death

objectives.name: Defeat Zote at the Colosseum of Fools
objectives.hopDescription: Attack Zote until the boss fight ends to earn the Rivalry achievement
objectives.note: Only available if Zote was saved both in Forgotten Crossroads and Deepnest

objectives.name: Obtain the Neglect achievement
objectives.hopDescription: Let Zote die in Forgotten Crossroads (do not save him before acquiring Mantis Claw), then hit his shell

objectives.name: Descend the well in Dirtmouth
objectives.hopDescription: Go down the well in Dirtmouth to enter Forgotten Crossroads

objectives.name: Reach Temple of the Black Egg
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the northeast of Forgotten Crossroads near the well entrance

objectives.name: Find Brooding Mawlek
objectives.hopDescription: Break the breakable wall south of the Hot Spring room to access the hidden area

objectives.name: Rescue Sly
objectives.hopDescription: Find Sly in one of the houses in the abandoned village near Salubra in the southeast

objectives.name: Reach Crystal Peak (upper connection)
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the east of Forgotten Crossroads to find the upper connection where Myla is mining

objectives.name: Use the Tram to reach Resting Grounds
objectives.hopDescription: Find the Tram connection in Forgotten Crossroads and ride it to the Resting Grounds

objectives.name: Encounter Garmond and Zaza
objectives.hopDescription: Find the NPC pair Garmond and Zaza who are on a quest to find a new home
objectives.note: Only confirmed from the Silksong announcement trailer; location within the game world unconfirmed

objectives.name: Dodge Elder Hu's Ring Curtain attack
objectives.hopDescription: Time dashes between the rings as they slam from the arena edges toward the centre; Shade Cloak simplifies this
objectives.note: Elder Hu stays in place during attacks and floats low — counter with Nail hits between ring pairs or use Spell build with Shade Cloak

objectives.name: Obtain Isma's Tear
objectives.hopDescription: Acquire Isma's Tear to gain access to the Love Key corpse location

objectives.name: Retrieve Love Key from Queen's Gardens
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the southeast of Queen's Gardens, above the path to Fungal Wastes, and collect the Love Key from a corpse
objectives.note: Requires Isma's Tear

objectives.name: Use Love Key in City of Tears
objectives.hopDescription: Bring the Love Key to its corresponding location in the City of Tears

objectives.name: Fight Elder Hu at his memorial
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the memorial above the gates to the City of Tears and use the Dream Nail to engage Elder Hu's spirit
objectives.note: Shade Cloak recommended; dodge Ring Slam and Ring Curtain, attack in gaps

objectives.name: Collect Love Key from Husk Dandy corpse
objectives.hopDescription: Find and collect the Love Key held by a large dead Husk Dandy in Queen's Gardens; optionally Dream Nail the corpse for lore dialogue

objectives.name: Obtain Vengeful Spirit
objectives.hopDescription: Locate and acquire Vengeful Spirit from its Point of Interest within Forgotten Crossroads

objectives.name: Obtain Soul Catcher
objectives.hopDescription: Locate and acquire Soul Catcher from its Point of Interest within Forgotten Crossroads

objectives.name: Escape the cage
objectives.hopDescription: Hornet escapes her cage before arriving at Pharloom's destination

objectives.name: Ascend Pharloom to its peak
objectives.hopDescription: Battle foes and solve mysteries while ascending on a deadly pilgrimage to Pharloom's peak

objectives.name: Manage Silk and Masks
objectives.hopDescription: Strike enemies to fill the Silk spool, then use Bind to restore Masks when the spool is full
objectives.note: Core health and resource loop

objectives.name: Equip Tools on a Crest
objectives.hopDescription: Collect Tools and equip them in Crest slots at a Bench to gain throwing weapons or defensive aids
objectives.note: Tools do not cost Silk

objectives.name: Find Garmond and Zaza
objectives.hopDescription: Encounter the NPC pair Garmond and Zaza who are on a quest to find a new home
objectives.note: Seen in the announcement trailer during the 'New Quests' segment

objectives.name: Retrieve the Love Key
objectives.hopDescription: Acquire Isma's Tear, then travel to the southeast of Queen's Gardens above the path to Fungal Wastes to collect the Love Key from a corpse
objectives.note: Requires Isma's Tear to access

objectives.name: Save Zote from Vengefly King
objectives.hopDescription: Find and defeat the Vengefly King holding Zote along the path to Greenpath in Forgotten Crossroads
objectives.note: Optional; if not done before getting Mantis Claw, Zote dies and only Neglect achievement is available

objectives.name: Save Zote before acquiring Mantis Claw
objectives.hopDescription: Return to Forgotten Crossroads and rescue Zote from the Vengefly King before obtaining Mantis Claw in Greenpath
objectives.note: Time-sensitive; missing this window locks Zote into his death state

objectives.name: Save Zote in Deepnest
objectives.hopDescription: Find Zote stuck in spider webs in Deepnest and free him
objectives.note: Requires having saved Zote in Forgotten Crossroads first; leaving him here does not result in his death

objectives.name: Rescue Zote from the Vengefly King
objectives.hopDescription: Fight the Vengefly King holding Zote captive on the path leading into Greenpath.
objectives.note: Optional — leaving Zote leads to his death if player acquires Mantis Claw first.

objectives.name: Reach Greenpath
objectives.hopDescription: Travel west from the Forgotten Crossroads to enter Greenpath.

objectives.name: Rescue (or abandon) Zote the Mighty
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the north part of Greenpath and deal with the Vengefly King attacking Zote

objectives.name: Defeat Hornet
objectives.hopDescription: Reach the arena in the northwest of Greenpath and defeat Hornet

objectives.name: Visit Lake of Unn and encounter Unn
objectives.hopDescription: Go to the northwest of Greenpath, west of Hornet's arena, and descend to the bottom of the Lake of Unn

objectives.name: Learn Great Slash Nail Art from Sheo
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate the thorn-filled southwestern path past Durandas to reach Sheo's Hut

objectives.name: Find the Stone Sanctuary
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the southeastern portion of Greenpath and descend the dark passage below the Bench room

objectives.name: Enter Greenpath
objectives.hopDescription: Obtain Vengeful Spirit from the Snail Shaman in the Ancestral Mound, then use it to defeat the Elder Baldur blocking Greenpath's entrance.
objectives.note: Gate-keeping requirement to access Greenpath at all

objectives.name: Obtain Love Key
objectives.hopDescription: Find and interact with the large dead Husk Dandy corpse in Queen's Gardens
objectives.note: Corpse can be Dream Nailed for dialogue: 'Too long... spent together. We become as one...'

objectives.name: Obtain Shape of Unn
objectives.hopDescription: Reach the Shape of Unn point of interest within Greenpath

objectives.name: Explore Stone Sanctuary
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the southeast part of Greenpath; bring Lumafly Lantern to illuminate the dark spike-filled sub-area
objectives.note: Warrior Dream No Eyes is found here

objectives.name: Defeat Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: Dodge Elder Hu's ring attacks by timing dashes (Shade Cloak recommended) and strike with Nail in between, or use Shade Cloak + Howling Wraiths/Abyss Shriek with a Spell build (Shaman Stone, Spell Twister, Soul Catcher, Soul Eater)

objectives.name: Reach Fountain Square and find Hornet
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate to the centre of City of Tears to encounter Hornet at Fountain Square

objectives.name: Unlock Relic Seeker Lemm
objectives.hopDescription: Defeat one of the Dreamers to make Lemm appear at Fountain Square

objectives.name: Defeat Soul Master in Soul Sanctum
objectives.hopDescription: Enter Soul Sanctum on the western side and defeat the Soul Master boss

objectives.name: Defeat Watcher Knights in Watcher's Spire
objectives.hopDescription: Enter Watcher's Spire on the eastern side and defeat the Watcher Knights boss

objectives.name: Defeat the Collector in Tower of Love
objectives.hopDescription: Enter Tower of Love on the eastern side and defeat the Collector boss

objectives.name: Access King's Station Stag Station
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the very eastern part of City of Tears to reach King's Station

objectives.name: Use the Hot Spring at Pleasure House
objectives.hopDescription: Find the Pleasure House in the eastern towers to access the only Hot Spring in City of Tears

objectives.name: Find the Love Key
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to Queen's Gardens to obtain the Love Key

objectives.name: Unlock the Tower of Love door
objectives.hopDescription: Use the Love Key on the door inside the Tower of Love
objectives.note: Requires the Love Key

objectives.name: Obtain the Love Key in Queen's Gardens
objectives.hopDescription: Find the large dead Husk Dandy in Queen's Gardens and collect the Love Key it holds; optionally Dream Nail the corpse for lore dialogue

objectives.name: Acquire Dream Nail before challenging Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: Obtain the Dream Nail ability to unlock the Elder Hu spirit fight at the City of Tears memorial

objectives.name: Dodge Ring Slam and Ring Curtain attacks
objectives.hopDescription: Use precise movement or Shade Cloak to avoid Elder Hu's ring attacks; attack him during openings or with Spells

objectives.name: Obtain Love Key from Husk Dandy corpse
objectives.hopDescription: Locate the large dead Husk Dandy holding the Love Key; optionally Dream Nail it for lore dialogue
objectives.note: Love Key location is noted in Queen's Gardens

objectives.name: Explore City of Tears Points of Interest
objectives.hopDescription: Collect Vessel Fragment, Simple Key, Grubs x2, Whispering Root (28 Essence near City Storerooms), Wanderer's Journals x2, Hallownest Seal, Geo Deposits x6, Soul Totem in City of Tears

objectives.name: Obtain the Dream Nail
objectives.hopDescription: Acquire the Dream Nail before challenging Elder Hu's spirit

objectives.name: Retrieve the Love Key in Queen's Gardens
objectives.hopDescription: Locate the large dead Husk Dandy corpse in Queen's Gardens to obtain the Love Key

objectives.name: Navigate Forgotten Crossroads
objectives.hopDescription: Explore the Forgotten Crossroads area of Hallownest

objectives.name: Explore Forgotten Crossroads
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate through the Forgotten Crossroads zone within Hallownest
objectives.note: Implied by the segment being a walkthrough page for this zone

objectives.name: Defeat False Knight
objectives.hopDescription: Confront and defeat False Knight in Forgotten Crossroads; noted as skippable

objectives.name: Navigate to Greenpath
objectives.hopDescription: Travel through Hallownest to reach the Greenpath area

objectives.name: Explore Greenpath
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate through the Greenpath zone within Hallownest
objectives.note: Segment title indicates this page covers Greenpath specifically

objectives.name: Chase Hornet to the Toll Bridge
objectives.hopDescription: Follow Hornet through Greenpath toward the toll bridge
objectives.note: A gate with a lever on the far side blocks upward progress at the toll bridge area

objectives.name: Find Thorns of Agony entrance
objectives.hopDescription: Locate the hidden entrance in Greenpath to acquire Thorns of Agony

objectives.name: Collect Greenpath Grub via pogo
objectives.hopDescription: Use a downward strike pogo jump to reach the grub in Greenpath

objectives.name: Collect Geo shell
objectives.hopDescription: Open gate to the left and collect the shell filled with Geos

objectives.name: Open gate back to map maker
objectives.hopDescription: Activate switch to the left to open gate leading back to the map maker's location

objectives.name: Speak with Snail Shaman
objectives.hopDescription: Climb up and enter the building to speak with the Snail Shaman and receive Vengeful Spirit

objectives.name: Navigate Ancestral Mound
objectives.hopDescription: Take the single path through Ancestral Mound, killing rolling Baldurs; find Soul Totem and Lifeblood Cocoon

objectives.name: Defeat Elder Baldur
objectives.hopDescription: Break barrier to far right, then use Vengeful Spirit at distance to hit Elder Baldur four times; kill Baldurs to replenish soul

objectives.name: Obtain Soul Catcher charm
objectives.hopDescription: After defeating Elder Baldur, run left to collect Soul Catcher charm, then break barrier and drop down to speak with Snail Shaman

objectives.name: Visit Grubfather
objectives.hopDescription: Return to Forgotten Crossroads hub, jump to very top and go left to find Grubfather; collect 100 Geo reward for four rescued Grubs

objectives.name: Head to Greenpath
objectives.hopDescription: Take the left path underneath the Grubfather to enter Greenpath

objectives.name: Buy map from Cornifer
objectives.hopDescription: Spend 60 Geo to purchase the Greenpath map from Cornifer
objectives.note: Player has 105 Geo at time of prompt; map costs 60 Geo

objectives.name: Navigate left through Greenpath
objectives.hopDescription: Hug left walls and descend midway to find the correct path through Greenpath

objectives.name: Use Vengeful Spirit to pass blocking enemy
objectives.hopDescription: Defeat the enemy blocking progression using Vengeful Spirit

objectives.name: Reach the three pillars area
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate to the top-left area of Greenpath marked by three pillar-like structures to locate Hornet's arena

objectives.name: Defeat Hornet to unlock dash
objectives.hopDescription: Enter Hornet's boss room and defeat her to obtain the Mothwing Cloak

objectives.name: Learn how to obtain movement abilities
objectives.hopDescription: Follow the guide to find each movement ability/key item and understand what it unlocks
objectives.note: Guide promises to cover requirements and locations for all movement abilities

objectives.name: Acquire Vengeful Spirit
objectives.hopDescription: Obtain Vengeful Spirit spell, needed to progress far enough into Greenpath to reach Hornet

objectives.name: Pick up Mothwing Cloak
objectives.hopDescription: Collect the Mothwing Cloak dropped by the fallen vessel after Hornet's defeat

objectives.name: Flip the lever in Mantis Village
objectives.hopDescription: Defeat or bypass Mantis and Mantis Youths guarding the lever in the lower section of the room

objectives.name: Reach the top path after lever flip
objectives.hopDescription: Return to the beginning of the room and take the upper route opened by the lever

objectives.name: Defeat two Mantis Youths guarding Mantis Claw
objectives.hopDescription: Clear the final room at the end of the upper path to collect Mantis Claw

objectives.name: Reach Crystal Peak via Forgotten Crossroads toll booth
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate to the left-side hallway of Forgotten Crossroads and pay the toll booth (requires Lumafly Lantern to see and pay it)

objectives.name: Reach Crystal Peak via Desolate Dive shortcut
objectives.hopDescription: Use Desolate Dive to break the floor of the mine shaft at the top-left of Forgotten Crossroads, above the toll gate

objectives.name: Navigate to Crystal Heart room in Crystal Peak
objectives.hopDescription: Head to the top of Crystal Peak, go left into the tall-ceiling room, then take the rightmost downward path to a large Golem with a lever; hit the lever for a shortcut, then enter the Crystal Heart area to the right
objectives.note: The Crystal Heart room features flip platforms with spike crystals underneath, conveyor belts, lasers, and enemies. Pogoing crystals with the nail flips platforms back upright. Crystals are not environmental hazards, so i-frames from damage allow standing on them.

objectives.name: Sit at the paid bench in Ancient Basin
objectives.hopDescription: Locate and optionally unlock the bench at the bottom-left of Ancient Basin before proceeding
objectives.note: Costs Geo to unlock; recommended as a nearby respawn point

objectives.name: Cross the spike corridor using Crystal Dash
objectives.hopDescription: Use Crystal Heart's Crystal Dash ability to traverse the long spike stretch to the left of the bench
objectives.note: Beware spikes at the far end; spawns next to them if hit. Cannot return up the hole once descended.

objectives.name: Break the shortcut wall
objectives.hopDescription: After passing the Mks (enemies), take the path up-right and break the wall for a shortcut back to the bench

objectives.name: Defeat Broken Vessel
objectives.hopDescription: Approach the infected goop corridor to trigger the Broken Vessel boss fight and defeat it

objectives.name: Obtain Monarch Wings
objectives.hopDescription: Follow the path through the now-open door after Broken Vessel; collect Monarch Wings at the end
objectives.note: Picking this up immediately transforms Forgotten Crossroads into Infected Crossroads

objectives.name: Defeat Dung Defender
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate to the bottom-right of Royal Waterways and defeat Dung Defender to unlock access to his mire

objectives.name: Cross crystal platform with Crystal Heart
objectives.hopDescription: Use Crystal Heart to dash across the crystal platform growing out of the ground in Royal Waterways
objectives.note: Follow the crystal formations to the right

objectives.name: Defeat Husk Sentries and find Dung Defender Sigil
objectives.hopDescription: Clear the Husk Sentry arena, then go up to retrieve the Dung Defender Sigil

objectives.name: Navigate through the mire to Isma's Grove
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate through the mire/maze after obtaining the Dung Defender Sigil to reach the room containing Isma's Tear

objectives.name: Open the door at the bottom of Ancient Basin
objectives.hopDescription: Use King's Brand to open the door at the very bottom of Ancient Basin
objectives.note: King's Brand must already be in possession

objectives.name: Navigate down and right through the Abyss
objectives.hopDescription: Drop down past spikes and void shadow entities, then go right past platforms

objectives.name: Climb the void siblings platforming section
objectives.hopDescription: Make your way up platforms while avoiding siblings (deal 2 damage on hit, do not grant Soul when struck)

objectives.name: Activate the Lighthouse lever
objectives.hopDescription: Reach the top of the platforming section and pull the lever to turn on the lighthouse, eliminating void liquid
objectives.note: Also contains Soul for healing

objectives.name: Cross the void liquid and reach the Shade Cloak
